data.name: Basitah
data.gender_notes: Basitah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Basitah is an Arabic name that means simple or uncomplicated. It is derived from the root word 'basata', which means to spread out or simplify. The name Basitah carries the meaning “Simple, Uncomplicated” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Basitah usually hope their child will grow to embody simple, uncomplicated and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, the word 'basata' is used to describe God's provision and blessings. Hence, Basitah can be seen as a name that signifies simplicity, humility, and trust in God's provision.
data.etymology: Basitah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Simple, Uncomplicated.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Basitah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
